landing.heroSub: Upload any medicinal plant photo. Instantly identify the exact species and predict its therapeutic pharmacology using advanced neural networks.
landing.bentoSub: Everything you need for botanical research in one unified platform.
landing.bento1Desc: Powered by Google Gemini, our system doesn't just identify the plant—it deeply analyzes the known chemical composition (alkaloids, flavonoids, terpenes) to predict potential therapeutic applications.
landing.bento2Desc: State-of-the-art leaf, flower, and bark recognition via Pl@ntNet API integration.
landing.bento3Desc: Instantly search our curated database of 150+ plants using scientific or local names.
landing.bento4Desc: Your botanical queries and uploaded images are processed securely without permanent retention.
landing.timelineSub: From a simple photo to deep pharmacological insights in seconds.
landing.step1Desc: Snap a picture of a leaf, flower, fruit, or bark. Our system accepts standard image formats.
landing.step2Desc: We query massive botanical databases to securely identify the exact plant species and retrieve its metadata.
landing.step3Desc: The AI analyzes the plant's chemical composition tags and predicts its therapeutic and medicinal applications.
landing.mobileDesc: Out in the field? No problem. Our mobile application allows you to snap photos and analyze plants completely offline with on-device AI models. Sync your discoveries when you're back in range.
landing.ctaDesc: Join researchers, botanists, and students discovering the chemistry of nature.
